meanings.meaning: To get used to a new climate, or to a new situation.
examples: It takes time to acclimatize to the thin air of high mountains.
She quickly acclimatized to her new job in a foreign country.
The soldiers had to acclimatize before starting operations in the desert.

meanings.meaning: To make used to a new climate or one that is different from that which is natural; to inure or habituate to other circumstances; to adapt to the peculiarities of a foreign or strange climate.
examples: acclimatize the staff to the new regulations
